mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in high inflation periods with rising CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive in periods of rising INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) level below 1100.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a quarterly decline in year-over-year GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an approaching economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not negative in late-cycle expansions with declining GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
